AUTOMATIC DUSTBIN LID

1.AIM  
To design and develop an automatic dustbin lid that opens when an object or hand is detected nearby using an ultrasonic sensor and a servo motor.

2\. Components Required  
Arduino UNO – 1  
HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor – 1  
SG90 Servo Motor – 1  
Dustbin with lid – 1  
Breadboard – 1  
Jumper wires  
USB cable

3\. Problem Statement  
Manual dustbin lids require physical contact, which can be inconvenient and may reduce hygiene. Therefore, an automatic lid system is designed to open the lid when a person brings their hand near the dustbin.

4\. Circuit Connections  
                              Arduino UNO:

HC-SR04 VCC —\> 5V

HC-SR04 GND —-\>GND

HC-SR04 TRIG —-\>D9

HC-SR04 ECHO —-\>D10

Servo Signal —-\>D6l

Servo VCC —-\>5V

Servo GND —-\>GND  
![][image1]  
5\. Working:  
The HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor continuously measures the distance of objects in front of the dustbin.  
When a hand comes within a preset distance, the sensor sends the information to the Arduino.  
The Arduino processes the distance value.  
If the object is close enough, the Arduino commands the servo motor to rotate.  
The servo lifts the dustbin lid.  
After a short delay, the servo returns to its original position and closes the lid. 

6\. Advantages:  
Touch-free operation  
Improves convenience and hygiene  
Simple and low-cost design  
Easy to operate  
Demonstrates sensor and motor control using Arduino

8\. Applications  
1)Homes  
2)Colleges and schools  
3}Offices  
4)Hospitals and other places where touch-free waste disposal is useful

9\. Result  
The automatic dustbin lid was successfully designed using an Arduino UNO, HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor and servo motor. The lid opens automatically when an object is detected within the set distance and closes after a short delay
